notes:
The landscape algebra draft carries two long diagonal cancellation strokes across both columns. Its left column gives top identities, a framed system, an xf_1 relation with adjacent eta formulas, a lambda expansion with lower annotations and local cancellations, a separate e_2/e_3 block, an upside-down marginal start and two bottom-left delta starts. The right column gives a braced system, an underlined identity, lower cases and descending equalities, a circled beta=0, alpha=±1, a signed delta-eta result, joined initials and two final identities. No title, date or author page number is established. Archive numeral 3 is recorded in a comment.

Of twelve actual C doubt loci, five are resolved and seven retained. The equals below the box and the cancelled xf_1 and f_1 are resolved. The lower even-case eta index reads i−1, with a following e_1; the ensuing written result still has i+2. The first expansion e-index remains i/1. A detached upper stroke at the final f_2 in the cancelled tail remains bar/arrow/plain-f uncertain. Paired ticks, an isolated dot and a second lower box rule are included.
